recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore Device.subject in core unless the work group reopens the DeviceAssociation model; future related changes should target DeviceAssociation.
issue_request: FHIR-30243 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for R5 asking to rename Device.patient to Device.subject and allow Patient, Practitioner, and Person references for RTLS-style tracking.
initial_application: Git commit b8ca3beefba3e8de406db820d71bae446430910c applied the seed by renaming Device.patient to Device.subject, adding Practitioner and Person targets, adding a Device-subject search parameter, and retargeting Device-patient to Device.subject.where(resolve() is Patient).
additional_context: Later final decisions changed the model: FHIR-34135 removed Person as a direct participant, FHIR-32570 moved subject into a Device association model, and FHIR-38904/FHIR-39226/FHIR-39009 resolved the conflict by moving patient/subject association data out of Device into DeviceAssociation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current Device has no active Device.patient or Device.subject element, DeviceAssociation is active and approved, DeviceAssociation.subject carries the association target, and DeviceAssociation subject/patient search parameters provide the active query surface.

related_jiras.note: Removed Person from Device.subject because Person is not a direct participant resource.
Removed Device.subject in favor of a Device association subject model.
Final DeviceAssociation disposition removed patient/subject association data from Device and created DeviceAssociation.
Explicitly reconciled the conflicting Device subject Jira family and linked the resolution to FHIR-38904.
Companion published issue pointing the patient-association move to FHIR-38904.
